text.en:
The National Productivity Commission, hereinafter referred to as the Commission, is hereby created
and attached to the National Economic Development Authority.

In implementing its functions, the Commission may call upon the assistance of any government or
private entity. Particularly, it shall establish the close coordination with the National Wages Council, the
Ministry of Labor and Employment, the Ministry of Industry, and the Ministry of Agriculture.

The Commission shall be composed of the Minister of Labor and Employment and the Minister of
Industry as Co-Chairman, with the Minister of Economic Planning, Minister of Agriculture, President of the
Development Academy of the Philippines and two representatives each from workers and employers
organizations who shall be appointed by the President to serve a term of three years, upon recommendation of
the Co-Chairmen as members. The Government representatives in the Commission may designate their
deputies in case they cannot attend the meeting of the Commission.

The Commission shall be assisted by a Secretary to be headed by an Executive Director who shall be
its Chief operating officer.

Upon the recommendation of the Commission, the President shall appoint an Executive Director. The
Commission shall prescribe the qualifications of the Executive Director.

The Chairman of the Commission shall appoint the personnel necessary to perform its functions and to
determine their qualifications and compensations, subject to pertinent civil service, compensation and
budgetary laws.

The Minister of the Budget shall immediately make available such funds as may be adequate to meet
the operational requirements of the Commission for calendar year 1980. Beginning, with calendar year 1981,
an appropriate yearly fund allotment to the Commission shall be included in the General Appropriations Act.

The Commission shall issue the appropriate rules and regulations to carry out the provisions of this
Executive Order.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 18th day of August, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and eighty.
